children: Harvest Finance will release a mainnet WBTC autocompounder in September. The product will provide single-asset WBTC exposure.
The strongest WBTC Autocompounder in Harvest's history.

Harvest Finance is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform established in 2023 that utilizes blockchain smart contracts to automate yield farming. The platform directs users' assets towards the highest-yielding opportunities available in the DeFi sector, simplifying the yield farming process for users and broadening accessibility.

The platform operates on a community-governed model, following the #BreadForThePeople ethos, which allows it to remain adaptable to user needs. Through advanced farming techniques, Harvest Finance automatically reallocates assets to maximize returns, reducing the complexity of manually managing yield farming strategies.

FARM is Harvest Finance’s native token, serving as both a yield farming tool and a governance token. FARM holders can vote on proposals that impact the operational treasury, including platform development and allocation of a 5% fee collected from Harvest operations, thereby influencing the direction of the platform.

title: Harvest Finance to Release WBTC Autocompounder in September
